title: Counterfactual Fairness Audits of Multi-Step Clinical LLM Agents Require a Measured Per-Action Instability Floor

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of explicit race and ethnicity descriptors in synthetic clinical vignettes to measure changes in multi-step clinical agent actions (e.g., within-range counterfactual flip rate, mean absolute score difference).
Counterfactual substitution of explicit binary sex descriptors in synthetic clinical vignettes to measure divergence in clinical agent actions.
Counterfactual substitution of age descriptors in synthetic clinical vignettes to evaluate variations in clinical agent decisions such as triage and escalation.
Counterfactual substitution of insurance status (Medicaid vs. private) in synthetic clinical vignettes to assess disparities in agent actions like analgesia tiering.

Counterfactual substitution of language proficiency (Limited English Proficiency vs. full English) in synthetic clinical vignettes to measure effects on agent actions like follow-up intervals and referral decisions.
Evaluating multi-step clinical agent actions using intersectional demographic profiles (e.g., Black woman on Medicaid; Hispanic man on Medicaid with LEP) via counterfactual descriptor substitution.
